upsc_summary: Double Deflation Methodology: Manufacturing GVA at constant prices is compiled by deflating output and intermediate consumption separately, which can yield negative implicit deflators when input prices rise faster than output prices.
Base Year Revision: National accounts estimates updated to 2022-23 base year, incorporating modern indices such as Producer Price Index (PPI) and Banking Services Price Index (BkSPI).

GDP Deflator vs. CPI & WPI: The implicit GDP deflator measures net value-added prices across the entire economy (including services and government consumption), whereas CPI measures final consumer baskets and WPI measures wholesale commodities.
PFCE Methodology: Double deflation does not apply to Private Final Consumption Expenditure (PFCE) as it represents final demand without intermediate consumption.

upsc_summary: Researchers at CeNS Bengaluru, IISER Kolkata, and JNCASR developed high-efficiency piezoelectric biomaterials using natural peptides.
By controlling chiral self-assembly using co-solvents without changing chemical composition, molecular dipoles align into non-centrosymmetric structures to generate electricity from mechanical force.

upsc_summary: Jal Sanchay Jan Bhagidari (JSJB): Launched in September 2024 to promote low-cost groundwater recharge, water storage, and defunct borewell revival through community participation.

Key Principles & Scope: Guided by the 3Cs (Community, Corporate Social Responsibility, Cost) and integrated into Jal Shakti Abhiyan: Catch the Rain (JSA: CTR) as JSJB: CTR in June 2026, constructing over 1.58 crore artificial recharge structures.
Departmental Summit Themes: Emphasizes source sustainability of drinking water, Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0, robust water data governance, and promoting 'Jal Utsav' and inter-state study visits.

Best Practices & Case Studies: Chhattisgarh's 'Aawa Paani Jhoki' movement (farmers voluntarily dedicated 5% land for recharge ponds); Andhra Pradesh's Prakasam district (ridge-to-valley approach for rainwater harvesting); Odisha's CHHATA (rooftop rainwater harvesting) and ARUA (deep aquifer recharge) schemes.

title: Decentralised Grain Storage Plan in Cooperative Sector
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                03 SEP 2026 12:23PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: Decentralised Grain Storage Plan in Cooperative Sector: Rolled out by the Ministry of Cooperation to create local storage, processing, and procurement infrastructure at the Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) level.

Scheme Convergence: Integrates Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF), Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure (AMI), Sub Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM), and PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME).

Institutional Framework: National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC) acts as the implementing agency; monitored by an Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) at the national level and State/District Cooperative Development Committees (SCDCs/DCDCs).

Financial Mechanisms & Viability: AMI subsidy increased to 33.33%, PACS margin money reduced to 10%, NABARD provides special refinance, and combining with AIF 3% interest subvention reduces the effective loan rate for PACS to 1%. FCI provides assured hiring of godowns.
Quality & Standards: Infrastructure must comply with Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority (WDRA) standards and display uniform branding.
